cells.tense: The clearing has already happened in this room, and you stand in it with the pen down.
cells.act: keep the ritual and give it room to change
cells.ask: Take a habit you kept through the change and alter one piece of it this month — same shape, one piece different.
cells.core:
Something finished, and you're on the far side of it with your footing intact. Nothing is being suppressed and nothing hurried. What's over is over, and what's next gets felt rather than forced. That's why two hard things can sit with you at once — a friend's trouble, a decision, a loss — without either one tipping you off your center.

Take a habit you kept through the change and alter one piece of it this month. Same shape, one piece different. Keep the ritual and give it room to change. What the change shows you, you'll know by doing it, and the doing is the whole of it. What's cleared stays cleared.

cells.verb: keeping the note true as the song moves under it
cells.place: the room after the ending, matter settled and floor cleared

cells.tense: You are arranging how this ending will look to everyone after it, bracing for a calm not yet here.
cells.ask: Name what you actually want out of what's ending, then make the first move toward it today, before you feel settled.
cells.core:
You want the room calm before anything is allowed to move, and getting it calm has become the work. Sharp things get smoothed before they're said, endings get softened before they're allowed, and what's already over gets kept because letting it end means someone is unhappy. The calm arrives early — before the clearing it should follow — and the distinctions that keep you centered get folded into it.

Name what you actually want out of what's ending, then make the first move toward it today. Start before you feel ready. The step can be small and unannounced; it only has to be real and yours. Moving from what you actually feel will do more for this room than any amount of arranging how it looks.
cells.sheetLine: The calm is arriving before the clearing.
cells.verb: keeping the note true as the song moves under it
cells.place: the room after the ending, matter settled and floor cleared

cells.tense: You are still facing a threshold whose ending already happened on the other side.
cells.act: feel it alongside them and keep your own side
cells.ask: Stay with someone while they're in something hard, and while you feel it with them, hold your own edge — yours, not theirs.
cells.core:
Whatever closed is closed, and you keep filling the space it left with whoever is nearest, which scatters you a little more each time. The center is hard to find because you keep leaving it to avoid the quiet. You face a threshold whose ending already happened on the far side, and it won't move while you stand watching it.

Stay with someone while they're in something hard. Feel it with them, and hold your own edge — yours, not theirs, not merged. Not to keep them away; to feel your own side again, which is the part that's come loose. Contact with your own edge brings the center back. Filling the space does not.

cells.tense: You are in a room you have already cleared, and you have not noticed the clearing was yours.
cells.act: hand one thing on in the way you were handed it
cells.ask: Pass along something someone taught you — a way of doing a thing, a phrase — to whoever needs it now, the way it came to you.
cells.core:
There's a way you keep things steady through change that other people have learned from you, and you don't count it as anything you did. You describe the room as just how it is now, as if the clearing happened to you rather than through you. It holds because you keep holding it. When someone asks how you got through, you say time, or luck, and the answer moves on.

Pass along something someone taught you — a way of doing a thing, a phrase — to whoever needs it now, the way it came to you. Hand one thing on in the way you were handed it. It doesn't have to be large or wise. Passed along, it shows you what you've been carrying without saying so, and the room gets its author back.
cells.sheetLine: The clearing was yours. You'd say it was just time.

cells.place: the room after the ending, matter settled and floor cleared
